name: Kepler-1656
description: Star of 5,696 K, 186 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Angelo et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-1656 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Angelo et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-1656 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

temperature.source: TICv8, the stellar temperature of Kepler-1656 b's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: Kepler-1656 b crosses Kepler-1656 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius follows Angelo et al. 2022, and its temperature TICv8.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2019, ANGELO_ET_AL__2022): st_teff 5696, st_rad 1.1, st_mass 1.03

notes: Kepler-1656 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
